claims.claim: The bound-only cubic/quintic source response has O(epsilon^2) local phase size and integrated squared compact trace on critical time.
The QP compact trace equals the paid physical component plus the exact residual response and an O(epsilon^2) position correction; the residual remains open.
The mixed carrier 2sqrt(3)-sqrt(w) reaches the threshold at w=4/3, and the full stationary cubic coefficient for c^2 conjugate(b) has nonzero imaginary threshold moment 6sqrt(3)d_b.
Under ET's sine convention, its resonant leading phase is exp(i pi/4), not i; the sqrt(t) order is unchanged.
Quadratic shape history, continuum-bearing residuals, the actual small-shape hierarchy and full critical action transfer remain unpaid.
